name: grid
title: Grid
summary: The layout of every display: a Cartesian grid of bordered cells, divided by hairlines that run edge to edge.
use: To lay out everything inside a pane: an inspector, settings, a form, a bank of knobs.
As a section: a header cell, then one cell per parameter.
anatomy: Cells padded by the spacing unit
Hairlines between rows and columns, full bleed
A mono label top-left in each cell, content one unit below
Optional header cell: the section name in ink with trailing tools
Swift: DSGrid with DSGridHeader, DSCell and .dsSpan(_:)

options.name: columns
options.description: Columns per row; hairlines divide the columns too.

options.name: span
options.description: Columns a cell takes. Without it a cell takes the row; knobs take one.

options.name: title
options.description: A cell's name, as a mono label top-left.

options.name: header
options.description: A header cell across the row: the section name in ink, tools trailing.

rules: Every padding and gap is the spacing unit: space-4 regular, space-3 compact.
Hairlines meet the edges of the pane; no gutters, no cards.
The last cell of a row stretches to its end, so every row is whole.
Every section is the same: header cell first, then parameter cells; knobs three to a row.
accessibility: Each titled cell is a labelled group.
